newsitem.title: USA: QMS sees Q3 oper shr loss $0.30 a share.
newsitem.headline: QMS sees Q3 oper shr loss $0.30 a share.

text.p: Document imaging company QMS Inc on Monday said its third quarter preliminary results from operations show a loss of about $0.30 per share.
The company's prediction excludes a special charge of $2.2 million, $0.20 per share, in conjunction with a realignment in its executive ranks.
The company recorded earnings of $0.15 a share in the third quarter of 1996.

Earlier, QMS said it plans to replace company founder James Busby as president and chief executive and former executive vice president and chief operating officer Charles Daley, will come out of retirement to again serve in those official capacities.
